questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 4: Pollinator Visits Through the Day
Observers counted visits to equal flower patches during four 30-minute periods. They recorded bee and butterfly visits separately. Weather remained clear, and the patches contained the same flower species and similar numbers of open blooms.

Which statement correctly identifies variables in the study?

options.A: The measured outcome was held constant in every trial.
options.B: No condition was intentionally varied or classified.
options.C: The graph title was the dependent variable.
options.D: Observation time and pollinator group were classification variables; visit count was the measured outcome.

questions.explanation: The correct choice distinguishes the factor varied or classified from the outcome measured.
